item.title: Global household wealth hit a record $570 trillion. Only a fifth of the increase was newly created.
item.dc:creator: The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)
item.description: Eight numbers from last week's Kobeissi Letter, lined up in a row. Apart they are separate stories. Side by side they point the same way.
